D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: John Garamendi leads by 50.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 133,289 votes; a one point swing is about 1,321 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +43.6 and D +56.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.2M cash against $235. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
